verses.1: The hand of Jehovah is never short in saving those who are in need, and His ear is never closed when it comes to hearing their cries.
verses.2: For if your sins were separated from you by God, and if your transgressions covered your faces from Him.
verses.3: For in your blood you have been pierced, and your lips have spoken lies against each other. Thus, you will be brought low.
verses.4: There is no justice in this world, and there is no true judgment. Everything is done in haste and without consideration for others.
verses.5: The eggs of the locusts will be destroyed, and the fruits of the acacia trees will wither. The food from their eggs will die, and the seeds will rot away.
verses.6: Their deeds shall not be considered as righteousness, nor shall their actions be regarded as good deeds. Their actions are the works of darkness, and they bear the burden of sin upon their shoulders.
verses.7: Their feet were directed towards evil; they rushed forward to shed innocent blood from their hearts. They shed the blood of those who were innocent, like the blood of sheep and lambs.
verses.8: They did not know the path to peace. There was no justice in their ways. All their paths led them astray; they did not know what peace really meant.
verses.9: Therefore, let them be far away from us. Let them not seek justice for us. It’s dark for those who are blind; they walk in darkness.
verses.10: It was like walls that had been torn apart; it was as if there were no eyes at all. It was like we were in the middle of chaos and destruction, like those who died.
verses.11: May we all be like sheep that are led by one shepherd. May we be willing to submit to judgment and hope for salvation from this situation. It’s far away from us.
verses.12: For our sins have turned against you, and our faults have brought us to ruin. Our sins have destroyed us; they know this very well.
verses.13: He is a sinner and a traitor to God. He tries to escape from our Lord. His words are false and deceitful.
verses.14: And from judgment and righteousness, he was separated far away. He stood there because the true path was lost, and he couldn’t come any closer.
verses.15: And truth became clear, and evil was removed from the world. Jehovah saw this, and His eyes were filled with joy, for there was no more injustice.
verses.16: And he saw that there was no one around. So he slept, for there was no harm. His descendants and his righteousness were his salvation.
verses.17: And he carried out justice like a lion, and he held salvation in his hands. He wore garments of vengeance, and he wore the cloak of jealousy.
verses.18: As for those who are like camels, they will be rewarded with kindness for their hardships. They will be given help and support from those who are in need.
verses.19: And they shall fear His name from the darkness of night, and from the east of the sun, for His glory will come like a narrow river. The wind of Jehovah will blow through it.
verses.20: And a prophet came to Zion, and to the tribes of sinners in Jacob. May the LORD have mercy on them.
verses.21: And this is my covenant with them. The LORD says, “My spirit shall rest upon you, and my words that I have placed in your mouth, they shall not leave your mouth, nor your descendants’ mouths, nor the mouths of your descendants’ descendants. From now on, and forever.”
